lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed as a semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. A primary horizontal axis of larger spots is situated along the mid-flank, with smaller clusters forming parallel rows dorsally and ventrally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a series of anchor nodes in a rectangular lattice across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible, defined by a high-contrast gradient (light-to-dark top-to-bottom). These run longitudinally from the post-branchial region toward the posterior.
